record.paper_title: Open problems in the theory of fuzzy metric spaces
record.context_brief: Density of finite fuzzy metric spaces in CFM.
record.original_question: Is the collection of finite fuzzy metric spaces dense, with respect to the fuzzy Gromov-Hausdorff metric, in CFM, the space of isometry classes of compact fuzzy metric spaces?

evidence.quote: Question 2. Is the space of finite fuzzy metric spaces dense in CFM?

artifact.status_search_result: Search results show ongoing work on fuzzy Gromov–Hausdorff distance, including a 2025 preprint on a Gromov–Hausdorff compactness theorem for non-Archimedean fuzzy metric spaces, but no source explicitly resolves the density of finite fuzzy metric spaces in CFM. Status is therefore not verifiable as solved or open from the available evidence.

status_evidence.title: Gromov-Hausdorff compactness theorem for non-Archimedean Fuzzy Metric Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: A Gromov-Hausdorff compactness theorem in the setting of compact non-Archimedean fuzzy metric spaces is developed, with related precompactness results.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work develops Gromov–Hausdorff-type theorems for fuzzy metric spaces but does not directly settle density of finite spaces in CFM.
